bias_targets.methodology: Proposing the RECAP benchmark to evaluate demographic sensitivity by assessing an agent's ability to represent diverse, structured reasoning paths across intersecting demographic identities (e.g., race, class, gender) rather than defaulting to homogenous or majority-class stereotypes.

Analyzing multi-agent interactions to evaluate if synthetic populations artificially converge on median perspectives and suppress epistemic disagreement due to shared autoregressive parameters and global priors.
